title: Use Group I – uses permitted by special permit
previewText:
For uses denoted with “○” in Section 22-111 (Use Group I – general use allowances), the following provisions of this Section shall apply:

Outdoor racket courts or skating rinks may be permitted in R1 or R2 Districts by special permit of the Board of Standards and Appeals, in accordance with Section 73-111 (Outdoor racket courts or skating rinks). Sand, gravel or clay pits may be permitted in all Residence Districts

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Reorganized use provisions into new use group structure in Sections 22-11 through 22-18, inclusive; incorporating special permit references from Section 22-20, inclusive, into use group provisions
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
